papers.title_en: Demonstration-Based Robotic Feeding Using Dynamic Movement Primitives
papers.authors: Kenzhi Iskandar Wong, Kitti Thamrongaphichartkul, Sri Harsha Turlapati, Yanshuo Lu, Kanichi Doi, Boyu Ma, Bin Zhou, Lin Yang, Ananda Sidarta, Lek Syn Lim, Arun-Kumar Kaliya-Perumal, Jianfei Yang, Domenico Campolo
papers.evidence: 机器人通过视觉感知和学习运动原语完成喂食交互
papers.tldr: 机器人辅助进食需要协调勺子舀取与送入口部的动作，并适应餐盘和使用者嘴部的位置变化。研究通过动作捕捉记录人的勺子轨迹，将舀取和送食阶段分别编码为动态运动基元，再利用深度相机及 AprilTag 定位餐盘和嘴部目标。Kinova Gen3 实机实验展示了系统在感知场景中依序执行动作并复现示范轨迹的可行性。该集成框架为将人类示范、视觉定位与机器人控制用于辅助进食提供了实现方案。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a demonstration-based robotic feeding framework that integrates human demonstration, Dynamic Movement Primitive-based motion planning, vision-based scene perception, and robot control. A human operator first demonstrates the scooping and feeding motions while the position and Euler-angle orientation of the spoon are recorded using a motion-capture system. The recorded trajectory is segmented into scooping and feeding motions, which are encoded using separate Dynamic Movement Primitives. Before task execution, an RGB-D camera estimates the participant's mouth position, while two AprilTags are used for robot-frame registration and tray localization. The detected tray pose is used to position the scooping motion, whereas the detected mouth position defines the positional goal of the feeding motion. The approach, scooping, and feeding trajectories are then executed sequentially by a Kinova Gen3 manipulator through a ROS~2-based framework. A real-world experiment demonstrates the feasibility of the integrated pipeline and shows that the learned spoon motions can be reproduced within the detected experimental scene.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting: A Few-Shot Learning Perspective on Overfitting Prevention
papers.authors: Lejia Ye, Bin Wu, Jingjing Gao, Yiyang Wu, Xiaohu Zhang
papers.evidence: 稀疏视角下改进三维高斯场景重建
papers.tldr: 稀疏视角新视角合成对有限观测下的场景重建提出挑战，三维高斯泼溅在此条件下易过拟合、几何质量也会退化。论文从少样本学习重新审视该问题，将每个高斯基元类比为神经元，并统一引入监督增强与训练正则。方法以光流引导合成伪视角并联合优化相机和场景，同时采用运动感知丢弃与提前停止。实验在SIGGRAPH Asia 2025体积视频挑战稀疏视角数据集上显著胜过优化式和前馈基线，最终获得该赛道第一，为稀疏视角重建提供了系统化思路。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view novel view synthesis (NVS) is essential for AR/VR and real-time communication applications, yet remains challenging when reconstructing 3D scenes from limited viewpoints. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) excels in dense-view scenarios, it suffers from overfitting and geometry degradation under sparse inputs. Current approaches often tackle these problems from a local perspective, addressing either data quality or training regularization individually, lacking a unified and interpretable framework for systematic improvement.   We introduce a new perspective that reframes sparse-view 3DGS from a few-shot learning viewpoint, treating each Gaussian primitive as a neuron and leveraging deep learning regularization techniques. Under this unified framework, our approach generates more effective supervision from scarce observations through two strategies: (1) data-related supervision enrichment via optical flow-guided pseudo-view synthesis and joint camera-scene optimization; and (2) training-time regularization via motion-aware dropout and early stopping, which suppress overfitting while preserving dynamic-scene stability. Extensive experiments on the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 volumetric video challenge sparse-view dataset demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art optimization-based and feed-forward baselines. Our system won first place in the sparse-view track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 challenge.

papers.title_en: MAPLE: Mondrian-Anchored Prior for Learning-free Indoor Exploration
papers.evidence: 根据局部地图预测未知空间并估计探索收益，直接支持机器人在室内环境中导航。
papers.tldr: 室内机器人在未知环境探索时，常需根据局部观测决定下一步，而传感器范围外的未知区域会使前沿收益估计失准；既有预测方法往往依赖离线训练与反复推理。MAPLE将Mondrian过程改造为在线生成先验，依据当前部分地图中的几何线索生成多个可能地图，并分别计算各假设中的可见性与前沿收益。实验在KTH平面图和真实SLAM环境、多种传感器量程下显示，它稳定优于不做预测的探索，并可与学习式方法竞争。该方法无需训练且计算轻量，同时表明预测精度并非探索效果的唯一关键，预测表示及其决策用法同样重要。
papers.abstract_en: Robots exploring unknown indoor environments must decide where to move while much of the environment remains unseen. Predicting the occupancy of unseen space beyond the current sensor range can improve these decisions, but recent approaches commonly rely on learned models that require offline training and repeated inference during exploration. We introduce the Mondrian-Anchored Prior for Learning-free Indoor Exploration (MAPLE), a training-free predictive approach that adapts the Mondrian process into an online generative prior conditioned on observed geometric cues in the current partial map. MAPLE generates multiple plausible map hypotheses and evaluates visibility separately within each to estimate frontier gain, preserving differences in predicted visibility across hypotheses. Across KTH floor-plans and real-SLAM environments at multiple sensor ranges, MAPLE consistently improves over non-predictive exploration and remains competitive with learned predictive approaches. Its lightweight procedural construction enables predictive exploration with limited computational resources. Experimental results further show that more accurate map prediction does not necessarily produce better exploration, highlighting the importance of how predictions are represented and used in exploration decisions.

papers.title_en: Real2Sem2Real: 3D Semantic Augmentations for Robot Learning from a Single Human RGB Demonstration
papers.authors: Matthew Strong, Ankush K. Dhawan, Julien Poffet, Giuse Pham, Jinho So, Monroe Kennedy
papers.evidence: 从人类演示生成机器人操作训练数据，涉及具身学习与物体交互。
papers.tldr: 人类示范视频易于规模化获取，却难直接转化为机器人可用数据；现有方法还受深度传感、二维叠加或物体实例范围限制。R2Sem2R从单段单目RGB视频追踪物体三维位姿，将数字孪生与目标物体及功能区域语义对齐，并把人手动作映射为机器人抓取。它可在仿真中约两小时生成逾2000段示范。在两种真实机器人和四项任务中，单视频数据训练的策略在多样物体上达到或超过遥操作训练策略，展示了扩展机器人学习数据的途径。
papers.abstract_en: Human video scales easily and does not need robot hardware, but existing methods require depth sensing, overlay the robot onto 2D video, or generate data only for the demonstrated objects. We present Real2Sem2Real (R2Sem2R), a real-to-semantic-to-real pipeline that turns one monocular RGB video of a human demonstration into thousands of robot demonstrations across the semantic object instances of a category. R2Sem2R tracks the SE(3) pose of each object with DINOv3-distilled Gaussian splats, outperforming existing methods and FoundationPose with estimated metric depth. R2Sem2R then aligns digital cousins, each generated from one or a few photographs, to the demonstrated objects with a semantic alignment. This alignment matches whole objects and the functional regions of target objects, such as a coffee machine's tray. R2Sem2R maps the human hand to a feasible robot grasp that extends to the cousins. Robot demonstrations are generated either in IsaacSim, for photorealistic rendering, or MuJoCo, for contact physics, and R2Sem2R can generate over 2,000 episodes in about two hours. On two real robots and four tasks, we train a vision-language-action policy on data from one human video per task, and policies trained on our data match or exceed policies trained on teleoperation across diverse object instances. The project page is available at https://real2sem2real.github.io/.

papers.title_en: PhyMo: Learning Physical Dynamics with Accurate and Continuous Motion from Multi-View Videos
papers.authors: Shangjia Liu, Jinxi Li, Siyuan Zhou, Bo Yang, Bing Wang
papers.evidence: 从多视角视频恢复动态三维几何与物理运动
papers.tldr: 从多视角视频恢复动态三维场景，既要重建几何与外观，也要还原驱动场景演化的真实运动。仅靠渲染监督时，模型可能用颜色或透明度弥补形变错误，快速或局部复杂运动尤其容易造成轨迹失真和预测不连续。PhyMo提出运动感知轨迹表示，从形变中恢复准确运动，并用连续运动演化模块及双向运动学约束协调位移、速度和加速度。四个动态场景基准上的实验取得当前最佳表现，验证了其几何忠实插值与连续运动外推能力。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering dynamic 3D scene geometry, appearance, and the physical motion states that govern scene evolution from multi-view videos is important yet challenging. A key difficulty is that appearance can be deceptive. Under rendering supervision alone, a model may fit the observed images by changing color or opacity to compensate for inaccurate deformation, rather than recovering the true evolving geometry and motion. This issue is especially severe in scenes with fast or locally complex motion, where inaccurate trajectories can still produce plausible images over the observed frames, but lead to unreliable reconstruction and discontinuous future prediction. In this paper, we propose PhyMo, a framework for learning evolving dynamics from multi-view videos. We introduce a Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation that drives the model to recover accurate motion from deformation, rather than relying on appearance shortcuts to explain observed motion. On top of this, we propose a Continuous Motion Evolution module with bidirectional kinematic continuity constraint to promote temporally consistent evolution of displacement, velocity, and acceleration. Together, these designs yield geometrically faithful interpolation and continuous motion extrapolation. Experiments on four dynamic scene benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance.

papers.title_en: CRAB: Cuboid-based Representation for As-built BIM from Point Clouds
papers.authors: Haoran Xiong, Jing Wang, Shanshan Pan, Zihao Yan, Minglun Gong, Hui Huang
papers.evidence: 从点云重建带语义和参数的建筑构件，与扫描几何生成三维模型直接相关。
papers.tldr: 从点云生成竣工建筑信息模型，不仅要恢复平面与表面，还需获得墙体厚度、门窗洞口及可编辑的构件语义与参数。CRAB以建筑构件长方体统一表示墙、门、窗、梁和柱，结合ProposalNet粗提议与关系感知的AssemblyNet流匹配细化，并支持结构纠正和人工编辑。实验显示其构件完整性、几何精度和泛化优于平面图及平面模型方案；墙厚估计平均误差为2.80厘米，79.50%的匹配墙误差低于3厘米。该方法还扩展结构化场景数据、提供构件长方体标注，推动点云结果进入可编辑且兼容IFC的建筑信息模型流程。
papers.abstract_en: As-built BIM reconstruction from point clouds demands semantic, volumetric, parametric, and editable building components, beyond 2D layouts or planar abstractions. Yet existing scan-to-BIM pipelines often rely on handcrafted rules, heuristic optimization, or manual correction, while learning-based methods fall short of recovering wall thickness, opening geometry, and component-level BIM structure. We introduce CRAB, a BIM-ready cuboid reconstruction framework that encodes walls, doors, windows, beams, and columns as compact architectural cuboids with IFC-compatible semantics and parameters. CRAB bridges point clouds and editable BIM by combining ProposalNet, which predicts coarse component cuboids, with AssemblyNet, a relation-aware Flow Matching model that refines geometry, predicts structural relationships, and enables automatic structural correction and human-guided editing. To address limited cuboid-level supervision, we extend Structured3D with component-wise cuboid annotations and construct cuboid-based procedural scenes. Experiments show CRAB surpasses floor plan and plane-based alternatives in component completeness, geometric accuracy, and generalization. For interior wall thickness estimation, CRAB achieves a mean error of 2.80 cm, with 79.50% of matched walls within 3 cm. The project page is available at https://vcc.tech/research/2026/CRAB.

papers.title_en: Linear Twisting Sidewinding Gaits for Twistable Snake Robot Motion Planning on Complex Terrains
papers.evidence: 提出蛇形机器人在复杂地形中的新型运动规划步态
papers.tldr: 蛇形机器人侧向蜿蜒能适应多种地形，但仅靠躯干波动限制速度与机动性；已有结合扭转的滚动向量方法虽能提升运动能力，却把扭转载荷集中在短缓冲段及中部两个关节，容易使电机过载。论文提出线性扭转函数构造的新型扭转侧蜿步态，将工作负载分配到全身。转向速度与总输出功率相同条件下，单个扭转关节峰值功率降低42%；实机可通过既有方法难以通过的地形，速度较传统无扭转侧蜿提高最高49%。这为复杂地形下兼顾负载、速度与鲁棒性的蛇形机器人运动规划提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Sidewinding is an efficient gait for snake robots to locomote on various terrains, by undulating the backbone curve and shifting the contact segments along it. However, relying solely on undulatory motion limits the locomotive capability of snake robots, and combining it with twisting motion can improve their speed and robustness. This hypothesis has recently been verified by the rolling vector approach, which locomotes the robot like a differential-drive car. Yet its twisting is concentrated in a short buffer segment, imposing most of the workload on the two twist joints in the middle, which can often overburden the motors and limit its locomotion. With that in mind, this paper develops a new family of twisting sidewinding gaits that distribute the workload over the entire body with our proposed linear twisting function. Under matched turning speed and total output power, our gaits reduce the peak output power of a single twist joint by 42%. Real-robot experiments show that, with the reduced workload, our new gaits can locomote the robot in various terrains that the existing rolling vector approach cannot. Besides, our new gaits can move up to 49% faster than conventional sidewinding without twisting.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
papers.authors: Yanzhe Chen, Ziyi Yang, Jifeng Zhu, Qiming Huang, Ruihe An, Peiyao Xu, Hesen Yang, Runda Liu, Chang Gong, Zhijun Cao, Zechen Bai, Wenzheng Zeng, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.evidence: 提出涵盖感知、预测、规划、行动与验证的具身智能体框架
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体从电脑操作走向机器人操作后，必须在物理动态中感知环境、采取行动并依据反馈调整决策。为刻画这一转变，论文提出PAPAV统一框架，以感知、预判、规划、行动和验证五项功能描述智能体，不依赖具体架构。对64项基准的分析显示，评测明显偏重行动，仅5项评估预判、3项评估验证，任务成功率难以揭示这些能力。该框架为比较多模态智能体与机器人系统、设计可靠物理智能体及改进全面评测提供共同基础。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

papers.title_en: TEAR: Task-Evidence Authority Routing for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Shicheng Zhang, Hui Liu, Haoliang Li
papers.evidence: 研究机器人操作中的控制决策，结合遥操作和自主控制，直接契合具身交互任务。
papers.tldr: 野外机器人操作中，网络波动会削弱远程操控的可用性，而本地自主执行又容易受语义歧义、长时漂移和突发情况影响，因此关键不只是控制能力，也包括在线决定由谁掌权。TEAR在机器人端融合网络状态与任务语义证据，并结合机器人状态及当前控制权，以轻量时序仲裁器在远程人类操控和本地自主之间切换。仿真与真实动态网络试验中，系统成功率接近纯遥操作，但遥操作仅占19.8%—27.4%的控制步，并较纯自主提升30%—40%。结果表明，按任务与网络证据互补分配控制权，可在减少持续人工依赖的同时维持操作成功。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable robotic manipulation in field-deployed settings requires more than executing a capable controller. As the execution conditions change, the system must decide, online and on the robot side, which control source should hold authority. Human teleoperation adapts readily to contact-rich and semantically ambiguous situations but depends on a stable communication link. Local autonomy is executed without continuous human intervention, but may fail under semantic ambiguity, long-horizon drift, and unforeseen contingencies. These two control sources exhibit complementary reliability profiles. We formulate this complementarity as a control authority routing problem and present Task-Evidence Authority Routing for Robotic Manipulation (TEAR), an edge-deployable framework that allocates authority between human teleoperation and local autonomy. TEAR arbitrates on the robot side using network-state evidence, which governs the usability of teleoperation, and task-semantic evidence, which reflects whether autonomous execution remains consistent with the current task. A lightweight temporal arbitrator observes both forms of evidence together with robot state and current authority to time authority transfers. Across simulated and real-world trials under dynamic network conditions, TEAR achieves task success rates close to pure teleoperation while limiting teleoperation to 19.8-27.4% of control steps and improves success by 30-40% over autonomy-only execution in our settings. These results demonstrate the potential of complementary authority routing to sustain successful manipulation with substantially reduced dependence on continuous human control.

papers.title_en: HiP3R: Hierarchical Pose Graphs for Long-Horizon 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Zunnan Xu, Shangchen Zhou, Yihang Luo, Chen Change Loy
papers.evidence: 利用层级位姿图处理长时程三维重建中的漂移与回环
papers.tldr: 前馈模型擅长从短视频窗口估计相机运动与三维几何，但面对数千帧长视频时，计算和内存开销使整段推理难以实现，分块处理又会带来坐标系不一致及重复相机预测。HiP3R采用分层位姿图：先以块级Sim(3)优化全局布局和尺度，再固定布局，为每帧估计共享的SE(3)相机位姿。多项基准实验表明，该方法改善相机轨迹与三维重建。它无需额外训练或微调，并兼容分块及流式后端，为长时程重建提供兼顾全局一致性与局部灵活性的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at https://kkakkkka.github.io/HiP3R.

papers.title_en: Point-Level Refinable Semantic Mapping for Spatial Understanding
papers.authors: Taimeng Fu, Yi Du, Zitong Zhan, Qiwei Du, Shaoshu Su, Zhipeng Zhao, Chen Wang
papers.evidence: 维护可修订的开放词汇三维语义地图以支持机器人空间理解
papers.tldr: 开放词汇三维语义地图可作为机器人长期空间记忆，但常见追加式点整合难以纠正早期感知错误，物体移动或消失后过时点仍会残留。本文提出在线可精炼语义映射，为每个物体点维护置信度，并以多视角时序证据强化可靠点、抑制噪声与过时点，同时通过跟踪和重识别保持实例身份。实验在Replica和ScanNet上的映射精度分别提升3.46%和2.55%，并在动态场景与感知噪声下表现稳健。该方法还支持物体导航和具身问答，成功率分别为82.4%和76.7%，使空间记忆能够随观测持续修订。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic maps have emerged as a key spatial memory representation for long-horizon robot autonomy, enabling robots to reason about objects, their spatial relationships, and past observations across time. However, existing object-centric semantic maps are primarily designed for static environments and rely on an append-only point integration strategy, where newly observed points are accumulated but previously integrated points are rarely reevaluated. Consequently, perception errors accumulate over time, and outdated points persist after objects move or disappear. Although recent dynamic mapping methods update object-level representations in changing scenes, they do not explicitly revise noisy or obsolete points within each object. We propose an online refinable semantic mapping framework that continuously refines object representations through probabilistic point-level confidence updating. Each object point maintains a confidence score that is updated online using multi-view temporal evidence: consistent observations reinforce reliable points, while inconsistent segmentation masks, depth measurements, and visibility cues suppress spurious and outdated points. Combined with object tracking and re-identification to preserve instance identities under motion and relocation, our framework enables object-centric semantic maps to be continuously refined rather than monotonically accumulated. Experiments demonstrate improved mapping accuracy over the previous method by 3.46% on Replica and 2.55% on ScanNet, show robustness in dynamic environments and under perception noise, and provide an effective spatial memory for object navigation and embodied question-answering with success rates of 82.4% and 76.7%.

papers.title_en: SceneRig: An Agentic System for Simulation-Ready 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single Images
papers.authors: Rundong Luo, Yunong Liu, Di Cao, Matthew Tancik, Shyamal Buch, Colton Stearns, Wenqi Xian
papers.evidence: 从单张图像重建可供机器人操作的仿真就绪三维场景
papers.tldr: 机器人仿真需要大量多样场景，但从单张图像重建时，仅有视觉相似并不足够：物体还须准确识别、摆放并符合物理规律。SceneRig融合几何、视觉和物理工具恢复场景，再由智能体在模拟器中循环编辑与验证，提升场景稳定性。实验显示，它改善实例分割、物体外观和三维位置，且生成场景更能预测真实机器人策略表现，并支持可靠回放已记录的操作。该系统推动单图重建从看起来真实走向可编辑、可验证并能服务机器人仿真的实用场景。
papers.abstract_en: Simulation is a powerful tool for robotics, but building diverse, simulation-ready scenes at scale remains difficult. Reconstructing scenes from single images is a promising alternative, but visual similarity alone is insufficient: objects must also be recovered, accurately placed, and physically grounded. Existing methods that rely on post-hoc physics settling often misplace objects, producing scenes that look correct but behave poorly under manipulation. We present SceneRig, an agentic system that turns a single image into an editable, simulation-ready scene. SceneRig combines geometric, visual, and physical tools to reconstruct a faithful 3D scene. An agent then performs edit-and-validate loops inside a physics simulator to achieve physical stability. Across diverse inputs, SceneRig improves instance segmentation, object-centric appearance, and 3D placement while keeping the reconstructed scenes physically stable. Furthermore, SceneRig is effective for downstream robotics: its scenes predict real-robot policy outcomes more accurately than the baseline method and more reliably support replay of recorded manipulations without trajectory adaptation.

papers.title_en: PanoBench: A Panoptic Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Yi Feng, Zizhan Guo, Junwu E, Yu Ma, Mengtan Zhang, Jin Wu, Wei Ye, Hanli Wang, Qijun Chen, Danwei Wang, Rui Fan
papers.evidence: 多分辨率全景占用标注支持三维场景语义与实例理解
papers.tldr: 全景占用将三维几何、语义和实例身份统一表达，但现有数据集实例标注稀缺、场景覆盖有限，且真实观测重建常不完整。PanoBench整合合成与真实驾驶数据，提供多分辨率标注、持续实例身份和统一评测协议；真实数据通过几何先验与拓扑约束重建背景，并融合多视角前景网格。基准评测语义占用、全景占用和四维预测，分析标注质量、分辨率及跨域迁移，发现体素与射线指标互补，真实场景实例预测仍具挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Panoptic occupancy unifies 3D geometry, semantics, and instance identities, but its development is limited by scarce instance-aware annotations. Existing benchmarks mainly provide semantic labels reconstructed from incomplete sensor observations, while panoptic datasets have limited domain coverage or annotation completeness. We introduce PanoBench, a camera-centric panoptic occupancy prediction benchmark spanning synthetic and real-world driving scenes. It combines PanoBench-CarlaOcc, PanoBench-nuScenes, and PanoBench-KITTI360 through canonical data interfaces and unified evaluation protocols, providing multi-resolution annotations with persistent instance identities. The synthetic branch derives complete panoptic geometry from simulated meshes. For real-world data, a new pipeline reconstructs backgrounds using geometric priors and topology constraints, generates foreground mesh assets from multi-frame multi-view images, and fuses them into sparse panoptic voxels. A unified valid-mask protocol evaluates complete thing instances supported by temporal observations while scoring stuff regions at the voxel level. Analyses of observation fidelity, geometric completeness, spatial continuity, and temporal consistency demonstrate the benefits of the resulting annotations over existing occupancy benchmarks. We benchmark representative methods on semantic occupancy prediction, panoptic occupancy prediction, and 4D occupancy forecasting, and study voxel resolution, synthetic-to-real transfer, and storage efficiency. These results reveal complementary strengths of volumetric and ray-based metrics and persistent challenges in real-world instance-aware prediction. PanoBench is available at https://mias.group/PanoBench.

papers.title_en: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Yushi Lan, Zeren Jiang, Koichi Namekata, Xingang Pan, Chuanxia Zheng, Andrea Vedaldi
papers.evidence: 将前馈式四维重建作为视角生成的几何支架
papers.tldr: 从单目视频沿新相机轨迹生成画面，必须保留已观测场景的几何与运动，还要补全此前不可见的区域。Holo4D以重建器恢复的三维轨迹构成整体四维脚手架，将其投影到目标视角，并结合源视频外观、源视频及目标相机，条件化预训练视频扩散模型。实验显示，轨迹条件有助于相机控制和新视角合成。该方法无需重训生成器，可兼容不同四维重建器，并能受益于后续重建技术进步。
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing a monocular video from a new camera trajectory requires preserving the observed scene geometry and motion while completing regions that become newly visible. Feed-forward 4D reconstructors recover the structure of the observed scene, whereas video diffusion models provide a generative prior for completing unseen content. We introduce Holo4D, a video reshooting framework that uses reconstructed 3D trajectories as a holistic source-view 4D scaffold. We project these trajectories into the requested views and encode their geometry and source appearance to guide a pretrained video diffusion model. Together with the source video and target cameras, the scaffold grounds generation in reconstructed observations while leaving unsupported regions to the generative prior. Experiments demonstrate the value of trajectory-based conditioning for camera control and novel-view synthesis. The framework accommodates different 4D reconstructors without retraining the video generator, allowing it to benefit from future advances in source reconstruction. More details can be found in our project page.

papers.title_en: P$^3$-VLM: A Point-based Alternative for Grounded 3D Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Anna-Maria Halacheva, Jan-Nico Zaech, Sombit Dey, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel
papers.evidence: 三维场景中的点式视觉语言 grounding 与评测
papers.tldr: 现有3D视觉语言模型常以边界框作为空间提示或表示，框中丰富的类别线索可能造成语义泄漏，使模型不必充分理解场景视觉信息。实验显示，仅接收框坐标的盲语言模型也能取得较好成绩；改用单个三维点提示后，其在ScanNet的Nr3D准确率从36.4%降至18.0%。为此，论文提出无检测器、以场景为中心的P^3-VLM，通过位置、任务和上下文三条路径进行推理。在点提示的位置指向描述任务中，模型达到52.1%的准确率，并在鲁棒性、分布外泛化及无指向场景问答上展现优势。
papers.abstract_en: Examining existing benchmarks for grounding in 3D VLMs reveals a pervasive "semantic leakage" in the evaluation and prompting protocols: a heavy reliance on bounding boxes as spatial prompts or representation primitives. Because bounding boxes are highly informative of object categories, they introduce a shortcut for the models to neglect visual information during 3D VLM training. We demonstrate this with a "blind" LLM that, prompted only with the box coordinates, can perform surprisingly well. To further analyze this shortcut, we propose point-based grounding prompting - querying models with a single 3D point instead of a box. Under this protocol, the accuracy of the blind LLM drops from 36.4% to 18.0% on ScanNet's Nr3D, and similarly degrades for 3D VLMs (e.g. LL3DA).   Building on this insight, we introduce P$^3$-VLM, a novel tri-pathway 3D VLM that supports point-based prompts and achieves 52.1% state-of-the-art accuracy on location-grounded captioning under this setting. To achieve this, we redesign the architecture while keeping it detector-free, scene-centric, and suitable for 3D GS inputs. P$^3$-VLM utilizes three complementary pathways (location-, task-, and context-aware), enabling strong reasoning about scenes without any bounding box dependencies. The key benefit of point-based learning is a consistent improvement across settings: P$^3$-VLM achieves state-of-the-art performance under point-based grounding while also improving robustness, OOD generalization, and performance on ungrounded scene-centric 3D VQA benchmarks, reflecting its reduced reliance on bounding-box shortcuts and resulting stronger visual-spatial reasoning.

papers.title_en: Externalise the Memory: A Pre-Registered Study of Where an Embodied Agent's Experience Should Live
papers.evidence: 研究具身智能体如何存储和复用任务交互经验
papers.tldr: 具身智能体的经验应写入策略权重，还是在推理时外部检索，仍是关键问题。研究在视觉条件到达任务上，预注册比较记忆增强视觉语言教师、由其轨迹蒸馏的LoRA策略，以及给固定学生权重接入冻结检索库。蒸馏相对仅动作监督仅提升1个百分点且不显著，检索接入则提升34个百分点并达到教师49.3%的成功率；后续控制也显示检索可提升多种适配器。结果支持将经验外置而非仅压入权重，但更难任务优势未达显著，且可能受记忆覆盖限制。
papers.abstract_en: Should an embodied agent's experience be baked into its policy weights, or kept external and retrieved at inference? A memory-augmented teacher (a VLM that retrieves lessons, with their episode images, from its own past attempts) produces trajectories on a vision-conditioned reach task; from the same trajectories we distil LoRA student policies and evaluate them under matched protocols, including one that re-attaches the teacher's frozen retrieval buffer to a fixed set of student weights. We pre-registered the hypotheses, arms, tests, and analysis rules before training and before any p-value. Distilling the memory-augmented behaviour into weights beat an action-only control by +1 pp (n.s.); the registered test proves underpowered for its own minimum effect, so we withdraw - rather than refute - the memory-in-weights claim. Attaching retrieval to a fixed set of student weights added +34 pp (z=5.15), reaching the pooled memory-augmented teacher reference (49.3%); the pre-registered protocol contrast agrees (+23 pp, z=3.36); under a pre-registered auto-reset sensitivity count the two are +36 and +29 pp. An exploratory behavioural probe with pre-registered per-arm predictions is consistent with behavioural distillation transferring the marginal correction but not the conditional, situation-specific correction that retrieval supplies. The recipe that follows is to externalise the memory: in follow-up controls registered before they ran, the same frozen buffer lifts the base model with no adapter to 48% (sensitivity 48%) and the other three adapters from 19-26% to 53-55% (sensitivity 17-21% to 50-55%), and the adapter adds nothing detectable once the buffer is attached. On a second, harder task, the retrieval advantage points the same direction but falls short of significance (+6 pp, 95% CI [-4.5, +16.4]); exploratory diagnostics tie the attenuation to memory coverage.

papers.title_en: Gate3DGen: A Pre-processing Model that Selectively Purifies Real-World Images for 3D Generation
papers.authors: Xiaolin Li, Zihao Huang, Fanpeng Meng, Chen Yang, Guanjun Wu, Kai Zhang, Jiemin Fang, Qi Tian
papers.evidence: 为单图三维生成模型改善真实图像输入
papers.tldr: 单图三维生成在规范基准上效果较好，但真实照片中的光照不均、模糊与遮挡会显著损害生成质量。Gate3DGen作为无需重训生成器的选择性预处理模型，先识别并放行干净输入，再净化退化图像，同时保留物体身份、轮廓和纹理线索。研究通过三维资产渲染及合成退化构建成对训练数据，并以一步净化器和空间损失实施修复。合成测试中平均处理仅需2.3秒，TRELLIS.2网格距离相较退化输入降低61.5%；真实照片评估亦支持其保真能力，为稳健单图三维生成提供实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. Purifying such inputs requires deciding when to intervene and preserving the visual cues needed for 3D generation, while leaving clean inputs unchanged. We introduce Gate3DGen, a selective pre-processing model that gates image inputs to existing 3D generators without retraining them. A degradation-aware router bypasses inputs classified as clean and extracts features to guide purification of the remaining inputs. Conditioned on these features, a 3D-oriented one-step purifier purifies degraded inputs with spatial losses that encourage preservation of object identity, contours, and textural cues. To provide paired supervision, we construct a synthetic data engine that renders clean views of 3D assets and synthesises composite degradations. On the synthetic benchmark, the purifier improves image fidelity and downstream 3D geometry in only 2.3s on average, reducing TRELLIS.2 mesh distance by 61.5% relative to degraded inputs. VLM evaluation and human preferences on real photographs further support identity preservation and degradation correction. More demos and code are available at https://supra-3d.github.io/gate3dgen.
